subject: [PATCH 2/2] perf/x86/amd/uncore: Free counter slot by index

reviews.author: tip-bot2 for Usama Arif
reviews.summary: The patch was successfully merged into the perf/core branch of tip without any issues or concerns raised.

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch improves the performance of deleting events from a full PMU by using the recorded index directly and retaining the compare-exchange ownership check. This reduces the number of compare-exchanges required to delete all events from N * (N + 1) / 2 to just N.
